ops.title: 2026-07-19 wave (e9d8d2d5 + ca4d3233 + 25e96b90, unreleased atop v10.4.0): hatch_build fetches upstream truth (PyPI sdist → Cargo.lock/lib.rs/parsers.rs → crates.io node-types.json, sha256-pinned, XDG cache); langs.py = LANG_GLOBS+COMMENT_TYPES+DOC_COM
ops.body:
capt-hook doc-tables/derivation wave shipped 2026-07-19, three commits on origin/main, all CI green: `e9d8d2d5` (exports removal), `ca4d3233` (upstream derivation), `25e96b90` (doc tables done properly, after the user rejected inline hand-coded tables in ast_grep.py). Unreleased atop v10.4.0 — tag pending.

Durable facts:
- `hatch_build.py` now derives from ast-grep's own source, not probe heuristics: PyPI JSON → sdist (`Cargo.lock`, `crates/language/src/lib.rs`, `parsers.rs`) → static.crates.io grammar crates (`node-types.json`), sha256-pinned via Cargo.lock checksums, cached at `~/.cache/capt-hook-build/ast-grep-py-{v}/`. Regen: `uv run python hatch_build.py`. Stdlib-only; committed overrides live as small tables in hatch_build.py (KEY_OVERRIDES, EXTRA_PARSER_FNS, NODE_TYPES_SUBDIRS, COMMENTLESS_LANGS={"md"}).
- Generated+gitignored `captain_hook/langs.py` = LANG_GLOBS + COMMENT_TYPES + DOC_COMMENT_KINDS. `exports.py` is DELETED — the lazy-facade EXPORTS map is an inline literal in `__init__.py`. Header version skew (build env 0.44.1 vs venv 0.44.0 in the `>=0.44,<0.45` band) is by design; regen on the unmodified script first when reviewing generator diffs.
- DOC_COMMENT_KINDS rule: named kinds where `("marker" in kind and "doc" in kind) or "documentation" in kind` — exact across all 28 grammars (heredoc/nowdoc/haddock/doctype/document and rust's referenced `doc_comment` all miss); `build_doc_comment_kinds` fails loud if the result drops rust's two marker kinds.
- DOC_SIBLINGS is hand-maintained convention data in committed `captain_hook/doc_conventions.py` — measured NON-derivable (best structural rule 0/17 populated languages exact; 9/17 grammars have no usable declaration supertype; exact reproduction needs a 118-entry overlay vs the 110-entry table). Don't re-attempt derivation without new evidence. Both names still resolve from `captain_hook.ast_grep` for external packs.
- **pprint/repr byte-diff gates on frozensets are non-deterministic**: repr order follows per-process randomized string hashing, so a before/after snapshot diff false-fails ~93% of the time on identical values. Gate on value equality in one process (or sort-canonicalized renders), never on repr bytes.
- Ops lessons: a workflow subagent's background Bash dies with the subagent (its full-suite pytest orphaned at 68%); the implementer's 600s-capped foreground pytest overlapping its background rerun produced a transient 11-F cluster (test_nudge/test_pack_bootstrap) that vanished solo — rerun sole-owner before believing failures; full suite outruns the 600s Bash cap → session-owned background task, judge by exit code.
